en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 467 - It is narrated from Hasan bin Mahbub from Abdullah bin Sinan from Imam Ja’far Sadiq (a.s) that he said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: “Very soon will come a people after you, each of whom will be eligible for fifty times your reward. They said: O Messenger of Allah (s), we lived in your company, fought the Badr, Uhad and Hunain battles with you and the Holy Quran came down among us? The Prophet said: Indeed, if you were to face what they faced, you will not be as patient as them.”
